story.title: An Invitation to Help
story.text: Liu Zhang invites Liu Bei into Shu for help — he marches in and settles in the south.
story.narration: Liu Zhang of Yi Province had word of trouble to the north, so he sent for Liu Bei to bring men into Shu and help. Liu Bei set out from Jing Province and marched into Shu. At that time every camp, pass and city there still belonged to Liu Zhang. Liu Bei did not rush anything: he settled in the south first and waited for a chance to be of use.

story.title: One Place at a Time
story.text: Liu Bei steadies one place, takes the work there in hand, then moves north.
story.narration: Liu Bei did not try to take everything over at once. He began at Fu, taking the work of that place in hand first: holding the road, settling the people, and letting them come to know him. Only when that place was steady did he move north to the next — Jiameng Pass, then Luo, one place at a time, and finally Chengdu. There was no hurry: step by step, the work came into his hands of itself.

keyMoment.question: You are Liu Bei: you have just entered Shu, and every place belongs to someone else. What do you steady first?

options.text: Get a firm footing in one place, take the work there in hand, then move north
Take the whole of Yi Province in hand at one stroke
options.hint: That step is too wide — with one place not yet steady and the next already in mind, neither holds.

options.text: Take nothing in hand, and go back to Jing Province once the help is done
options.hint: Help and leave, and the place is still run by others — the journey would come to nothing.

keyMoment.reveal: Take it one step at a time — with a firm footing, people will hand the work to you by degrees.

misconceptions: You must be quick to catch an opening — slow means too late
Taking work in hand means taking what belongs to someone else
Doing everything in one go saves the most trouble

quiz.question: Why did Liu Zhang ask Liu Bei to come into Shu?
options: He wanted Liu Bei to bring men and help hold the border
He wanted to give Yi Province to Liu Bei
He wanted Liu Bei to be a teacher
quiz.explanation: It was Liu Zhang who invited him — that invitation was Liu Bei’s first step into Shu.

quiz.question: Once in Shu, why did Liu Bei take things over one place at a time?
options: Step by step, no one grows suspicious, and the work is taken in hand surely
He was waiting for Liu Zhang to speak first
quiz.explanation: One place steady before the next — that is the “by degrees” in turning from guest into host.

quiz.question: You have moved to a new class and want to get things done with everyone. What is the steadiest way?
options: Do your own part well, take one task after another in hand, and let them come to trust you
Announce on the first day that everyone listens to you from now on
Do nothing and wait to be chosen
quiz.explanation: It is not about seizing, but taking the work in hand step by step — like Liu Bei on the road into Shu.
